name: Cottontail Cottage Wildlife Rehab
neighborhoods: Westchester County (Purchase, NY); where NYC rescues send callers who have found a wild baby cottontail
region_note: WILDLIFE REHABILITATION - wild cottontails and other native wildlife (Westchester, takes NYC referrals)
notes: All-volunteer, licensed wildlife rehabilitators. The phone line is answered around the clock by voicemail; leave a message and they call back. Wild animals only: they are not a pet rescue, and everything they take in is wild and native to New York State. Mailing address P.O. Box 13, Purchase, NY 10577. Do not give a wild animal food or water while waiting. Intake: Call (914) 933-7559 at any hour and leave a message - they return calls as soon as they can
type_raw: Licensed wildlife rehabilitator (wild cottontails, foxes, raccoons and other native NY species)
